note: D6 `ttl`, the convert_radius key that pairs with `kind` and is dead without it: roots is the one TERRAIN row that decays with a table ttl of 0 (its comment already says the creator decides), so a palisade that did not stamp a ttl would raise a hedge that is gone on the next environment tick. Here the oil at (5,2) becomes roots with ttl 3, two end_turns take it to 1, and the water_jet on the third turn still finds a wall to slam the smokestack into (collision 2). Ignore the override - pass -1 into _tile_dict so the row's own ttl 0 is written - and the hedge is gone before the shove, the collision never happens and the record fails in plain mode on its last pattern. d6_palisade_kind is the same board pinning what the tile becomes
